resolution.note: ADR 0021 point 10 amended (Remember arm, 3-record cap, precision gate, executable-only Stop, cost+regression reporting, MDE 16 pp/n recomputed); seedStandards on fresh clone: 31 records, 0 project-own; plan item 5 and prereg match

title: ADR 0021 records the redesigned proof: Remember arm, 3-record cap, precision gate
body:
Source: operator grant 2026-11-18 (memory proof-redesign-grant) on the lead brief; evidence .krn/runs/lead/night/proof-path.md (literature: SkillsBench 2602.12670, arXiv 2603.15401, SWE-ContextBench 2602.08316, 2611.01181, 2602.11988; harness: evals/replay/arm-b.ts:69 B carries what C injects).
Outcome: ADR 0021 is amended before any re-freeze: (1) arm C includes Remember: units of one repo run in commit-date order and graded failures of earlier units propose evidence-gated records served to later units; (2) at most 3 records per retrieval moment with a precision gate; (3) Stop runs executable checks only, no review step; (4) cost per resolved task and regression rate are reported beside hidden-test pass rate; (5) the MDE and n are recomputed for the expected effect, citing the literature. First verify by command whether seedStandards (src/brain/standards.ts:337) yields project records on a fresh outside clone and record the result. Plan item 5 wording in docs/program/plan.md matches the ADR.
Files: docs/adr/0021-proof-methodology.md, docs/program/plan.md, evals/replay/abc.prereg.md
Proof: grep shows the ADR names the Remember arm, the 3-record cap, the precision gate and the recomputed MDE; the seedStandards check command and its output are cited in the ADR.
